InMemoryProjectRepository.save/findById store and fetch records in a Map<string, Project>. This is a persistence concern and belongs in infrastructure.

parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file holds three in-memory repository adapters (InMemoryUserRepository, InMemoryProjectRepository, InMemoryTaskRepository). Each one implements a repository interface declared in the domain layer. All they do is persistence: they store records in a Map, save them and look them up by id. findByProject filters on projectId, an optional status and an optional assigneeId. That is query or selection logic, which is normal for a repository. It does not enforce business invariants, state transitions or authorization. The file has no business rules, no transport handling and no application orchestration. Every responsibility fits the infrastructure layer.
